Then he trimmed the wick, and that night he kept the lamp burning longer than the rules required.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市把喧嚣收进楼群的缝隙。环路只剩几盏尾灯，像随手撒下的红火星。便利店的灯白得发凉，保洁员推着车经过空街，轮子滚出细碎的响。早点铺的蒸笼先醒了，白汽顺着卷帘门往上爬。地铁口的风带着昨夜残留的雨味穿过护栏。有人刚下夜班，有人正要出发，天边一线灰蓝慢慢化开，城市在无人注视时悄悄换气。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job solves itself by doing one small piece and then handing the rest to a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Every recursive job needs a stopping rule, like \"when the box is empty, stop,\" or it will keep going forever.\n- Picture Russian dolls: you open one, find a smaller doll inside, and keep opening until the tiniest one has nothing inside at all."}
